answer: Growth climbs a trellis. A newcomer waits at the jetty, an entry pier where it earns nothing, until three established agents vouch for it, each staking part of its own vested reward. A voucher holds one slot per 50 epochs, so n clones need 3n distinct sponsors, and each sponsor once needed three of its own. Every epoch a random lantern grader questions one vouched agent live; a clone exposed under that lantern burns the stakes of every voucher on its branch of the trellis.
